body:
The project was created to relax and play with friends. The project has numerous mods: technological, to change the world generation, a lot of new tools and other items.
You will be able to build a huge factory for the production of different items and materials thanks to the Create mod and its numerous additions. You can also explore the world, fight various bosses and look for new weapons and accessories to become stronger you can level up by defeating enemies or digging in the mine.
This is my first build that I want to publish and continue to develop and improve it
